verdict.rationale: Reclaim's own docs describe a natural-language chat assistant for interacting with your schedule, used to plan, prioritize, and optimize it (reclaim-docs-66, reclaim-docs-11). The 2.0 Schedule Assistant acts as a control center that suggests next actions and lets you preview calendar changes before deploying them (reclaim-docs-51, reclaim-docs-52). A community user also reports that shorthand text in Google Tasks reserves work time (reclaim-comm-11). missing for 10: documentation of which operations the chat can perform (e.g. creating or editing tasks and habits, changing settings) versus only advising, examples of supported commands, and independent hands-on corroboration of the chat assistant itself.
